summary: _ansible_tmpdir (str) is the temp directory created by the action plugin that module commands must use, exposed via the tmpdir property; its random name sits under DEFAULT_LOCAL_TMP, remote_tmp or system_tmpdirs, so ansible.cfg can't fully control it.
questions: Where should my module write temporary files?
Can I fully control the module temp directory path from ansible.cfg?
What happens if the action plugin didn't create a tmpdir?

answer_card.title: _ansible_tmpdir
answer_card.answer_md: Type `str`. Modules must use this temp directory; access it via `module.tmpdir`, which creates one if the action plugin didn't. The name is random under `DEFAULT_LOCAL_TMP`, the shell's `remote_tmp`, or `system_tmpdirs`, so `ansible.cfg` can't guarantee the full path.
